changes.content:
# Generated by terragucci.
# terragucci writes this file from terragucci.yml, or from its defaults when
# the repo has none. Change terragucci.yml and run `npx terragucci init`
# rather than editing it here.
# Every job runs in ghcr.io/intentius/terragucci-tofu:0.4.53-tofu1.13.1; init pins its digest once the image is published.
stages:
  - build
  - test
  - check
  - plan
  - apply
  - tips
  - deploy

check:
  stage: check
  image:
    name: ghcr.io/intentius/terragucci-tofu:0.4.53-tofu1.13.1
  variables:
    TF_IN_AUTOMATION: '1'
    TF_INPUT: '0'
    TG_BRANCH: '$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
  script:
    - |
      unset TG_TOKEN TG_MERGE_TOKEN CHANT_FORGE_TOKEN CHANT_GITHUB_TOKEN CHANT_FORGEJO_TOKEN CHANT_GITLAB_TOKEN CHANT_CHECKOUT_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN FORGEJO_TOKEN GITEA_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN CI_JOB_TOKEN ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN
      mkdir -p .chant/commit
      set +e
      (
      set -eu
      tofu fmt -check -recursive -diff . || exit 3
      failed=0
      tg_check() {
        dir="$1"
        tg_init tofu -chdir="$dir" init -backend=false -input=false -no-color >/dev/null || return 1
        terragucci check-root "$dir" --binary tofu
      }
      tg_init() {
        if [ -n "${TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR:-}" ]; then until mkdir "$tgtmp/init.lock" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; fi
        "$@"; rc=$?
        if [ -n "${TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR:-}" ]; then rmdir "$tgtmp/init.lock"; fi
        return $rc
      }
      tgtmp="$(mktemp -d)"
      n=0
      for dir in 'app' 'network'; do
        n=$((n+1))
        { export TERRAGUCCI_CHECK_PART="$tgtmp/$n.md"; if tg_check "$dir"; then echo 0 >"$tgtmp/$n.rc"; else echo 1 >"$tgtmp/$n.rc"; fi; } >"$tgtmp/$n.out" 2>&1 &
        eval "tgpid$n=$!"
      done
      wait
      n=0
      for dir in 'app' 'network'; do
        n=$((n+1))
        cat "$tgtmp/$n.out"
        if [ -s "$tgtmp/$n.md" ]; then
          mkdir -p terragucci-check; cat "$tgtmp/$n.md" >>terragucci-check/report.md
          if [ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]; then cat "$tgtmp/$n.md" >>"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; fi
        fi
        [ "$(cat "$tgtmp/$n.rc" 2>/dev/null)" = 0 ] || failed=1
      done
      terragucci check-policy || failed=1
      exit "$failed"
      )
      code=$?
      if [ "$code" -eq 3 ]; then echo "CHANT_COMMIT_FINDING=1" >.chant/commit/finding.env; else echo "CHANT_COMMIT_FINDING=0" >.chant/commit/finding.env; fi
      exit "$code"
  artifacts:
    name: terragucci-check
    when: always
    paths:
      - terragucci-check/
      - .chant/commit/finding.env
    reports:
      dotenv: .chant/commit/finding.env

fmt:
  stage: check
  image:
    name: ghcr.io/intentius/terragucci-tofu:0.4.53-tofu1.13.1
  resource_group: fmt
  timeout: '25 minutes'
  variables:
    CHANT_COMMIT_NAME: terragucci-fmt
    CHANT_COMMIT_ON: check
    CHANT_COMMIT_COMMAND: '["terragucci","fmt","--binary","tofu"]'
    CHANT_COMMIT_ALLOWED: '[]'
    CHANT_COMMIT_ALLOWED_FILES: '["*.tf","*.tofu","*.tfvars","*.hcl"]'
    CHANT_COMMIT_FINDINGS: '3'
    CHANT_COMMIT_MAX_RUNS: '3'
    CHANT_COMMIT_TIMEOUT: '10'
    CHANT_COMMIT_ENV: local
    GIT_DEPTH: '0'
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH != $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE != "schedule"'
      when: always
  needs:
    - job: check
      artifacts: true
  script:
    - if [ "${CHANT_COMMIT_FINDING:-0}" != "1" ]; then echo "the check found nothing, so terragucci-fmt does not run"; exit 0; fi
    - |
      case "$CI_COMMIT_SHA" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "no pushed commit" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
      git -c protocol.version=2 fetch -q --no-tags origin "+$CI_COMMIT_SHA:refs/chant/commit-head"
    - git fetch -q --no-tags origin '+refs/heads/chant/lifecycle:refs/heads/chant/lifecycle' 2>/dev/null || true
    - git remote set-url origin "$CI_SERVER_URL/$CI_PROJECT_PATH.git"
    - unset CHANT_FORGE_TOKEN CHANT_GITHUB_TOKEN CHANT_FORGEJO_TOKEN CHANT_GITLAB_TOKEN CHANT_CHECKOUT_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN FORGEJO_TOKEN GITEA_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN CI_JOB_TOKEN ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN
    - npx --no-install terragucci commit prepare --forge gitlab --output .chant/commit
    - npx --no-install terragucci commit run --forge gitlab --output .chant/commit
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - .chant/commit
    expire_in: '7 days'

fmt-push:
  stage: check
  image:
    name: ghcr.io/intentius/terragucci-tofu:0.4.53-tofu1.13.1
  resource_group: fmt-push
  variables:
    CHANT_COMMIT_NAME: terragucci-fmt
    CHANT_COMMIT_ON: check
    CHANT_COMMIT_COMMAND: '["terragucci","fmt","--binary","tofu"]'
    CHANT_COMMIT_ALLOWED: '[]'
    CHANT_COMMIT_ALLOWED_FILES: '["*.tf","*.tofu","*.tfvars","*.hcl"]'
    CHANT_COMMIT_FINDINGS: '3'
    CHANT_COMMIT_MAX_RUNS: '3'
    CHANT_COMMIT_TIMEOUT: '10'
    CHANT_COMMIT_ENV: local
    GIT_DEPTH: '0'
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH != $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE != "schedule"'
      when: always
  needs:
    - job: fmt
      artifacts: true
  script:
    - if [ ! -f .chant/commit/decision.json ]; then echo "terragucci-fmt did not run"; exit 0; fi
    - |
      case "$CI_COMMIT_SHA" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "no pushed commit" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
      git -c protocol.version=2 fetch -q --no-tags origin "+$CI_COMMIT_SHA:refs/chant/commit-head"
    - git fetch -q --no-tags origin '+refs/heads/chant/lifecycle:refs/heads/chant/lifecycle' 2>/dev/null || true
    - git remote set-url origin "$CI_SERVER_URL/$CI_PROJECT_PATH.git"
    - export CHANT_GITLAB_TOKEN="$GITLAB_TOKEN"
    - chant_auth="$(printf 'oauth2:%s' "$GITLAB_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
    - 'export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.extraheader GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="AUTHORIZATION: basic $chant_auth"'
    - unset chant_auth
    - npx --no-install terragucci commit land --forge gitlab --output .chant/commit

plan:
  stage: plan
  image:
    name: ghcr.io/intentius/terragucci-tofu:0.4.53-tofu1.13.1
  variables:
    TF_IN_AUTOMATION: '1'
    TF_INPUT: '0'
    TG_TOKEN: '$GITLAB_TOKEN'
    TG_SHA: '$CI_COMMIT_SHA'
    TG_BRANCH: '$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
    TG_PR: '$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID'
    GIT_DEPTH: '0'
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" && $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_PROJECT_PATH == $CI_PROJECT_PATH'
  script:
    - |
      bash <<'PLAN' || exit $?
      set +e -uo pipefail
      export TG_FORGE=gitlab
      tg() { case "$1" in status|note|reply|stale) terragucci post "$@" ;; *) node --input-type=module -e 'const [cmd, ...a] = process.argv.slice(1);
      const e = process.env, gl = e.TG_FORGE === "gitlab", tok = e.TG_TOKEN;
      try {
        if (!tok) {
          console.log("terragucci: no forge token, so no " + cmd);
        } else if (cmd === "alive") {
          const api = gl ? e.CI_API_V4_URL : e.GITHUB_API_URL || e.GITHUB_SERVER_URL + "/api/v1";
          const repo = gl ? "projects/" + e.CI_PROJECT_ID : "repos/" + e.GITHUB_REPOSITORY;
          const r = await fetch(api + "/" + repo + "/pipelines/" + a[0], { headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(gl ? { "private-token": tok } : { authorization: "token " + tok }) } });
          if (!r.ok) throw new Error("GET run " + a[0] + " answered " + r.status);
          const run = await r.json();
          console.log(["success", "failed", "canceled", "skipped"].includes(run.status) ? "dead" : "alive");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.log("terragucci: " + cmd + " failed: " + err.message);
      }' -- "$@" ;; esac; }
      tg status terragucci/plan pending "planning"
      terragucci stage tf-plan --out terragucci-report --binary tofu --layers 'network;app' --report-url "$CI_JOB_URL/artifacts/file/terragucci-report/report.html"
      rc=$?
      if [ ! -f terragucci-report/report.json ]; then
        tg status terragucci/plan failure "the plan report was not written"
        exit 1
      fi
      counts="$(node -e 'const r=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf-8"));const n=(a)=>r.named.filter((x)=>a.includes(x.action)).length;const f=n(["refused"]);console.log((f?f+" failed: ":"")+r.roots.length+" roots, "+r.groups.length+" groups, "+n(["delete","replace"])+" destroys")' terragucci-report/report.json)"
      if [ -n "${TG_PR:-}" ]; then
        note="$(mktemp)"
        # The first line says which roots the note covers, so an apply can mark it stale.
        { echo "<!-- terragucci:plan roots=$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf-8")).roots.map((x)=>x.path).join(","))' terragucci-report/report.json) -->"; cat terragucci-report/note.md; } >"$note"
        tg note "$note"
      fi
      if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then tg status terragucci/plan failure "$counts"; exit 1; fi
      tg status terragucci/plan success "$counts"
      PLAN
  artifacts:
    name: terragucci-report
    when: always
    paths:
      - terragucci-report/
    reports:
      terraform: terragucci-report/gitlab-terraform.json

apply-wave-1:
  stage: apply
  image:
    name: ghcr.io/intentius/terragucci-tofu:0.4.53-tofu1.13.1
  variables:
    TF_IN_AUTOMATION: '1'
    TF_INPUT: '0'
    TG_TOKEN: '$GITLAB_TOKEN'
    TG_SHA: '$CI_COMMIT_SHA'
    TG_BRANCH: '$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
    TG_BEFORE: '$CI_COMMIT_BEFORE_SHA'
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
  script:
    - |
      bash <<'APPLY' || exit $?
      set +e -uo pipefail
      export TG_FORGE=gitlab
      tg() { case "$1" in status|note|reply|stale) terragucci post "$@" ;; *) node --input-type=module -e 'const [cmd, ...a] = process.argv.slice(1);
      const e = process.env, gl = e.TG_FORGE === "gitlab", tok = e.TG_TOKEN;
      try {
        if (!tok) {
          console.log("terragucci: no forge token, so no " + cmd);
        } else if (cmd === "alive") {
          const api = gl ? e.CI_API_V4_URL : e.GITHUB_API_URL || e.GITHUB_SERVER_URL + "/api/v1";
          const repo = gl ? "projects/" + e.CI_PROJECT_ID : "repos/" + e.GITHUB_REPOSITORY;
          const r = await fetch(api + "/" + repo + "/pipelines/" + a[0], { headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(gl ? { "private-token": tok } : { authorization: "token " + tok }) } });
          if (!r.ok) throw new Error("GET run " + a[0] + " answered " + r.status);
          const run = await r.json();
          console.log(["success", "failed", "canceled", "skipped"].includes(run.status) ? "dead" : "alive");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.log("terragucci: " + cmd + " failed: " + err.message);
      }' -- "$@" ;; esac; }
      if [ -n "${TG_BEFORE:-}" ] && [ "${TG_BEFORE#0000000}" = "$TG_BEFORE" ] && git fetch -q --depth=1 origin "$TG_BEFORE" 2>/dev/null; then
        changed="$(git diff --name-only "$TG_BEFORE" HEAD)"
      else
        changed=
      fi
      moved=""
      for dir in 'app' 'network'; do
        if [ -z "$changed" ] || printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep "^$dir/" >/dev/null; then moved="${moved:+$moved,}$dir"; fi
      done
      # The base branch moved under these roots: plan notes that cover them are stale.
      tg stale "$moved" "${TG_BRANCH:-}"
      tg status terragucci/apply pending "applying"
      git remote set-url origin "${CI_SERVER_PROTOCOL}://oauth2:${TG_TOKEN}@${CI_SERVER_FQDN}/${CI_PROJECT_PATH}.git"
      outcome="$(mktemp)"
      log="$(mktemp)"
      TG_OUTCOME="$outcome" terragucci stage tf-apply --wave 1 --layers 'network;app' --binary tofu --gate on-destructive --stand-down 2>&1 | tee "$log"
      rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
      case "$rc" in
        0) ;;
        3) tg status terragucci/apply failure "$(cat "$outcome")"; exit 3 ;;
        4) tg status terragucci/apply failure "$(cat "$outcome")"; terragucci respond wave-refused --wave 1 --approved terragucci-report/approved --current terragucci-report/current || true; exit 4 ;;
        6) tg status terragucci/apply success "superseded by a newer push"; exit 0 ;;
        *) tg status terragucci/apply failure "an apply failed"; terragucci respond apply-failed --log "$log" || true; exit 1 ;;
      esac
      echo "wave 1 of 2 applied"
      APPLY
  artifacts:
    name: terragucci-report-apply-wave-1
    when: always
    paths:
      - terragucci-report/

apply-wave-2:
  stage: apply
  image:
    name: ghcr.io/intentius/terragucci-tofu:0.4.53-tofu1.13.1
  needs:
    - apply-wave-1
  variables:
    TF_IN_AUTOMATION: '1'
    TF_INPUT: '0'
    TG_TOKEN: '$GITLAB_TOKEN'
    TG_SHA: '$CI_COMMIT_SHA'
    TG_BRANCH: '$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
    TG_BEFORE: '$CI_COMMIT_BEFORE_SHA'
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
  script:
    - |
      bash <<'APPLY' || exit $?
      set +e -uo pipefail
      export TG_FORGE=gitlab
      tg() { case "$1" in status|note|reply|stale) terragucci post "$@" ;; *) node --input-type=module -e 'const [cmd, ...a] = process.argv.slice(1);
      const e = process.env, gl = e.TG_FORGE === "gitlab", tok = e.TG_TOKEN;
      try {
        if (!tok) {
          console.log("terragucci: no forge token, so no " + cmd);
        } else if (cmd === "alive") {
          const api = gl ? e.CI_API_V4_URL : e.GITHUB_API_URL || e.GITHUB_SERVER_URL + "/api/v1";
          const repo = gl ? "projects/" + e.CI_PROJECT_ID : "repos/" + e.GITHUB_REPOSITORY;
          const r = await fetch(api + "/" + repo + "/pipelines/" + a[0], { headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...(gl ? { "private-token": tok } : { authorization: "token " + tok }) } });
          if (!r.ok) throw new Error("GET run " + a[0] + " answered " + r.status);
          const run = await r.json();
          console.log(["success", "failed", "canceled", "skipped"].includes(run.status) ? "dead" : "alive");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.log("terragucci: " + cmd + " failed: " + err.message);
      }' -- "$@" ;; esac; }
      git remote set-url origin "${CI_SERVER_PROTOCOL}://oauth2:${TG_TOKEN}@${CI_SERVER_FQDN}/${CI_PROJECT_PATH}.git"
      outcome="$(mktemp)"
      log="$(mktemp)"
      TG_OUTCOME="$outcome" terragucci stage tf-apply --wave 2 --layers 'network;app' --binary tofu --gate on-destructive --stand-down 2>&1 | tee "$log"
      rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
      case "$rc" in
        0) ;;
        3) tg status terragucci/apply failure "$(cat "$outcome")"; exit 3 ;;
        4) tg status terragucci/apply failure "$(cat "$outcome")"; terragucci respond wave-refused --wave 2 --approved terragucci-report/approved --current terragucci-report/current || true; exit 4 ;;
        6) tg status terragucci/apply success "superseded by a newer push"; exit 0 ;;
        *) tg status terragucci/apply failure "an apply failed"; terragucci respond apply-failed --log "$log" || true; exit 1 ;;
      esac
      tg status terragucci/apply success "2 roots in 2 groups applied"
      echo "all roots applied"
      APPLY
  artifacts:
    name: terragucci-report-apply-wave-2
    when: always
    paths:
      - terragucci-report/

tips:
  stage: tips
  image:
    name: ghcr.io/intentius/terragucci-tofu:0.4.53-tofu1.13.1
  needs:
    - apply-wave-2
  variables:
    TF_IN_AUTOMATION: '1'
    TF_INPUT: '0'
    TG_TOKEN: '$GITLAB_TOKEN'
    TG_SHA: '$CI_COMMIT_SHA'
    TG_BRANCH: '$CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
    GIT_DEPTH: '0'
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
  resource_group: terragucci-tips
  script:
    - |
      bash <<'TIPS' || exit $?
      set -u
      export GITLAB_TOKEN="$TG_TOKEN"
      git remote set-url origin "${CI_SERVER_PROTOCOL}://oauth2:${TG_TOKEN}@${CI_SERVER_FQDN}/${CI_PROJECT_PATH}.git"
      terragucci respond tips --mode apply --binary tofu || true
      TIPS

# The repo's own pipeline.
include:
  - local: .gitlab/terragucci.yml

variables:
  APP: shop

unit-tests:
  script:
    - echo the repo's own job ran

tips.message: Provider "aws" is used in root module "app" but has no `required_providers` entry in `required_providers`. Add `source` and `version` for it in the terraform block's `required_providers`, so a future provider release can't silently change behavior.

Root module "app"'s terraform block has no `required_version`. Without it, an upgraded Terraform binary can change behavior with no version-check failure to flag it first. Add `required_version = ">= <lowest supported version>"`.
Root module "app" uses provider "aws" but has no .terraform.lock.hcl beside its .tf files. Run `terraform init` and commit the file, so every init selects the same provider versions.

Provider "aws" is used in root module "network" but has no `required_providers` entry in `required_providers`. Add `source` and `version` for it in the terraform block's `required_providers`, so a future provider release can't silently change behavior.

Root module "network"'s terraform block has no `required_version`. Without it, an upgraded Terraform binary can change behavior with no version-check failure to flag it first. Add `required_version = ">= <lowest supported version>"`.
Root module "network" uses provider "aws" but has no .terraform.lock.hcl beside its .tf files. Run `terraform init` and commit the file, so every init selects the same provider versions.
